A heartbreaking moment has emerged from the devastating floods in Nepal after a woman was rescued by the Nepal Army from a flood-hit area. After being brought to safety, she was seen sitting in shock, struggling to process the destruction around her. She had survived the dangerous floodwaters, but the disaster had left her facing the painful reality of losing everything she had. The emotional scene reflects the devastating impact of the floods on ordinary families across Nepal. For many survivors, escaping the water is only the beginning of a long and difficult journey to rebuild their lives. I usually don’t share these moments from when I travel for obvious reasons… I spent a month in Nepal last year, I was going on an evening walk and these little girls were following me asking for money. I decided to take them shopping instead.  It’s such a privilege to be able to travel, and giving back doesn’t have to be so complicated. Every detail speaks of grief, nature, loss, hope, and the strength of a nation standing together through tragedy. 🕊️ The flowing tears represent Mother Nature’s sorrow. The dramatic face paint reflects the pain of a nation mourning lives lost to devastating natural disasters. And the white dove carries a message of peace, remembrance, and prayer. 🤍🕊️ But beneath the sorrow is something even stronger — resilience.
